column1: # The updater scenarios: one row, one emulator run, the outcome fixed here.
# which builds the releases, starts the mirror and splits the rows by OS.
# Fields are TAB-separated; "-" is empty.  A row passes when every check of
# its files, rc, log, requester and mirror fields holds.
# THE CLI, which PRs 4-7 implement against.  ReadArgs template:
#       An update offers the Install / Later / Skip this version requester;
#       ANSWER= answers it without drawing it.  INSTALL then runs as below.
#       QUIET is the startup line: no output, nothing when AUTO=OFF or when
#       it already checked today, and it waits for the Workbench screen.
#       CHECK, then PREPARE and SWAP with no requester.  Without RESTART it
#       prints restart=needed and returns; RESTART reboots through
#   UpdateAmiNetXDuo BOOT        startup line, before anything opens
#                                bsdsocket.library: finish or undo a swap,
#                                count trial boots, roll back after 2
#   UpdateAmiNetXDuo CONFIRM     startup line, after Execute S:Network-Startup
#   rc  0 done, or nothing to do (current, AUTO=OFF, not due, skipped,
#         another stack active, a requester answered Skip)
#       5 an update is available and was not installed (Later, no answer)
#      10 refused (every refused= key below); nothing changed
#      20 failed after the first live file was touched
#   Every run writes its key=value lines to stdout (not with QUIET) and
#            version=<v>          (installed adds replaced= kept= skipped= missing=;
#                                  unchanged, rc 0: INSTALL found no file to
#                                  replace, adds kept= skipped= missing=, and
#                                  writes no trial and needs no restart)
#             [<amiga path>]   (pending: a swap is half done, BOOT ends it;
#                               or a trial waits for CONFIRM; busy: another
#            (a boot with nothing to do says nothing and logs nothing)
#            name <path>.otherbuild was taken; both copies stay)
#   phase: trial (INSTALL done; BOOT counts boots=), commit (CONFIRM saw
#   the network), confirmed, rollback (the third unconfirmed boot), and
#   rolledback (version= is the update taken out; CHECK skips it).
#   S:User-Startup, inside the installer's block, when it starts the
#   network: "<C>UpdateAmiNetXDuo BOOT QUIET" (its .old when a cut left only
#   <C> is C: or AmiNetXDuo:C/.  S:AmiNetXDuo-Install: version= flavour=
#   layout= docdir= libs= c= devs= channel=, written by the installer.
#   written by the installer (InstallSameFile RECEIPT); INSTALL refuses
#   no_receipt without one.  INSTALL leaves receipt-next (CONFIRM's), the
#   journal renamed to trial (its file= lines, for CONFIRM and the
#   rollback) and prior-old/<n> (each .old moved aside); the journal format
#   and its recovery are in src/tools/updinstall.h.
#   MIRROR=<url ending in />   the folder holding release/ and prerelease/
# TEST HOOKS, honoured only by a build with AMINETXDUO_UPDATE_TEST_KEY=ON,
# which knows exactly one key, test-a (tests/updater/test-only-update-key-a.pem):
#                                  that phase's n-th cut point write
#                                  prepare and swap count a sample, one
#                                  point per boundary: prepare 1 the first
#                                  (when one is), then half way (a live
#                                  file at .old, its .new not yet live),
#                                  the last "done", the rename to trial.
#                                  single step is cut on the host
#   layout     system | drawer | drawer@Upd (the drawer on its own FFS volume)
#   setup      comma list, applied before the action and each checked:
#              foreign=<f>    our file replaced by bytes with no AmiNetXDuo mark
#              otherbuild=<f> bytes with the mark and an older $VER
#              newer=<f>      bytes with the mark and a newer $VER
#                             a directory volume keeps no cleared d bit)
#              wpvolume       the drawer@Upd volume mounted read-only
#              fullvolume     the drawer@Upd volume filled to 32 KB free
#              foreignstack   a resident bsdsocket.library that is not ours,
#              clock=1978     the clock at 1-Jan-78 before S:User-Startup
#              noprefs        the settings file left as the installer wrote it
#              <f> is relative to the layout's drawers: C/ping, Libs/x.
#   action     ";" between boots, "," between the words of one boot.
#              install+restart | startup (no command: the startup lines
#              archive, over an update on trial; not in the harness yet) |
#              cut=each (every cut point of prepare and swap, each
#              followed by a recovery boot).  Every boot after the first
#              starts with how it starts: reboot (a power cycle), reboot+1d
#              (the clock one day on), restart (the guest reboots itself,
#              the session ends at the cut).
#   files      unchanged | new | old | atomic, plus modifiers:
#              keep=<f> absent=<f> old=<f> (a .old with the bytes before)
#              receipt (lists every placed file's new hash) filesrec
#   rc         one per CLI word, comma list; - none
#   log        ";" list: <prefix> a line starting so, in stdout or the log;
#              !<prefix> no such line; state:<k=v> a state line;
#              ustartup:<text> a S:User-Startup line; envarc:<k=v> a
#              settings line.  @OLD and @NEW are the two versions.
#   requester  a requester= key that must be logged; - none may be.  A
#              run from the shell prints its refusals and draws nothing.
#   mirror     per boot, comma list: none | manifest | container, @<channel>
#              to name the folder; - not checked
#   pr         the PR expected to make the row pass: 4 CHECK and integrity,
#              5 PREPARE and SWAP, 6 BOOT, CONFIRM, installer and receipt,
#              7 requester and prefs; harness = the harness cannot run it yet
